resources.string: TV layout for a remote control
A start page with YouTube search, remote buttons on the video, and words picked from a list. Off: this TV shows the phone layout.
On a video: OK plays or pauses, ◀ ▶ go to the previous or next line, ▲ replays the line, ▼ goes to the subtitles, and Back opens TV home. OK on a subtitle line shows its words.
Only on Android TV. Install this same app on an Android TV or Google TV to try it.
No videos found. Try other words.
Could not search YouTube. Check the connection and try again.
Search for a video in the language you are learning, or open the YouTube page. On a video, ◀ ▶ move between lines and ▼ goes to the subtitles.
